triage.hint: Cheapest fast model. Short classification over issue text.

intake.hint: Runs locally in your existing session. Use whatever you already pay for.

acAudit.hint: Runs on every PR. Cheap and fast; mechanical diff-to-AC mapping.

selfHeal.hint: Runs only on CI failure. Needs real reasoning over diff plus trace.

escalation.hint: Rare. Frontier reasoning for contested or ambiguous reviews.
